item.title: Fred Nile, former NSW politician and figurehead of the rightwing Christian Democratic party, dies aged 92
item.description: Controversial figure frequently took positions against drug use, abortion and homosexuality, but in later years supported legislation expunging homosexual convictions Get our daily political email , free app or daily news podcast The former New South Wales MP and longstanding figurehead of the rightwing Christian Democratic party, the Rev Fred Nile, has died aged 92. Nile was a member of the NSW legislative council for more than 40 years. He first entered the state’s upper house in 1981 and retired after unsuccessfully contesting the 2023 election.
